blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace Press Officer Claire Castro on Tuesday debunked a circulating report that she could be appointed as next associate justice of the Supreme Court (SC). The unconfirmed report also said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was eyeing Associate Justice Rodil Zalameda to succeed Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, who will retire on Nov. 6. The report said that this situation could open up a seat on the high court for Castro. READ: Claire Castro stays; she’s a ‘treasure in this gov’t’ – PCO Sec.
